image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of two street signs mounted on a dark metal pole against a building facade. The left sign is a colorful, artistic square panel with abstract shapes and text in Hebrew and English ('CIRCUS'). The right sign is a standard rectangular white traffic sign with black Hebrew text and numbers, appearing slightly distorted or warped. The background shows architectural details of a building.

The abstract art style makes it hard to judge, but the transitions between colors show slight bleeding and lack the sharp crispness of printed vinyl or paint on metal.
The sign appears to float slightly or merge ambiguously with the pole/background. The physical mechanism holding it up is missing or visually incoherent.
